limitations: Isolated real components with synthetic data, not authenticated route integration.
85 migrated files are direct presentation sources; 62 are represented by related workflow families.
Family representation does not prove every conditional control or every route state was directly rendered.
Known baseline mobile document overflow and clipped/overlapping content remain layout failures.
The visual matrix tests real browser ArrowDown/Escape/Tab; actual Enter activation is separate browser-form evidence. Per-control jsdom activation includes an explicit click fallback.
